_README: This is a TEMPLATE. Do not edit this file with real values.
Instead, generate your OWN profile.json by capturing your own login once.
The two hex fields below are LOGIN FRAMES captured from a real login.
They cannot be typed by hand: they encode your machine-id, Steam session
id, and account token. cc_login.py extracts them from your own capture.
The identity block is filled in automatically from those frames.
hello_empty: <hex login frame, generated by cc_login.py from your capture>
hello_auth: <hex login frame, generated by cc_login.py from your capture>

identity.token: <your account token, from your own login>
identity.steam_id: <your steam id, or empty for a password account>
